title: Structured Query Construction
summary: This module provides tools to construct structured queries from natural language inputs using an LLM. It includes a chain for generating queries based on document attributes and an output parser to transform LLM responses into a structured query object.

nodes.label: Load Query Constructor Chain
nodes.title: load_query_constructor_chain
nodes.description: Initializes an LLMChain to construct structured queries based on document attributes, examples, and constraints.

nodes.label: Structured Query Output Parser
nodes.title: StructuredQueryOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses LLM-generated text (JSON markdown) into a structured query object, handling filter directives and optional corrections.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: An external language model responsible for generating query components based on the provided prompt.

nodes.label: Query Construction Prompt
nodes.title: BasePromptTemplate
nodes.description: A dynamically generated prompt template that guides the LLM in formulating structured queries.

nodes.label: LLM Chain
nodes.title: LLMChain
nodes.description: The core chain component that orchestrates the LLM call and subsequent output parsing.

nodes.label: Structured Query Object
nodes.title: StructuredQuery
nodes.description: The final structured query object, encapsulating the query string, filter conditions, and optional limit.

nodes.label: Generate Query Prompt
nodes.title: get_query_constructor_prompt
nodes.description: Helper function to create the specific prompt template for the query construction process.

nodes.label: Parse JSON Markdown
nodes.title: parse_and_check_json_markdown
nodes.description: Utility function to safely parse JSON content embedded within markdown strings.

nodes.label: Get Filter Directive Parser
nodes.title: get_parser
nodes.description: Retrieves or creates a parser specifically for filter directives, considering allowed comparators and operators.

nodes.label: Fix Invalid Filter Directives
nodes.title: fix_filter_directive
nodes.description: Corrects or adjusts filter directives that may be invalid based on predefined rules and allowed components.
